# emby_library (Resource)

Manages an Emby library (virtual folder).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_type` (String) The collection type (e.g. movies, tvshows, music, books, homevideos, musicvideos, mixed). Changing this forces the library to be recreated.
- `name` (String) The library name.
- `paths` (List of String) The file system paths for the library. At least one path is required.

### Read-Only

- `guid` (String) The library GUID.
- `id` (String) The library ID.
- `item_id` (String) The internal item ID used for policy bindings (e.g. EnabledFolders).
- `locations` (List of String) The file system paths for the library, as reported by the server.
